**UPDATES EVERY WEDNESDAY.**

JOIN THE DISCORD 👉 https://discord.com/invite/pickaboom

**WELCOME, MINER. CONGRATULATIONS ON JOINING PICKABOOM!** IF YOU’RE A HARD WORKER, A GOOD SHOT AND A RELIABLE TEAM PLAYER, YOU SHOULD HAVE RESPECTABLE ODDS OF SURVIVAL.
